scene_description: Black-topped table against a cream wall. A hole punch, hand sanitizer pump, tape dispenser and wire letter tray of paper are packed side by side along the wall. An electric pencil sharpener stands alone in front of the tray. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: hole punch
targets.description: Black and silver three-hole punch at the left end of the row along the wall, its long side running front to back.
nearby_obstacles: Hand sanitizer touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Left side is open, but the sanitizer presses against its right side.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the hole punch approximately 10 cm left, away from the sanitizer.

targets.name: hand sanitizer pump
targets.description: Hand sanitizer pump bottle standing against the wall, squeezed between the hole punch and the tape dispenser.
nearby_obstacles: Hole punch touching its left side
Tape dispenser touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Only the front is open; both sides and the back are blocked.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the sanitizer approximately 15 cm forward, out of the gap between its neighbors.

targets.name: tape dispenser
targets.description: Black tape dispenser standing against the wall between the sanitizer and the letter tray.
nearby_obstacles: Letter tray touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Only the front is open; it is pressed between the sanitizer and the tray.

candidate_improvements.description: Pull the tape dispenser approximately 15 cm forward, clear of its neighbors.

targets.name: letter tray of paper
targets.description: Black wire-mesh letter tray holding a stack of printed paper, against the wall at the right end of the row, with the pencil sharpener in front of it.
nearby_obstacles: Tape dispenser touching its left side
Pencil sharpener in front of its right half
targets.clearance_notes: Right side and part of the front are open; the sharpener limits a straight pull forward.

candidate_improvements.description: Unplug the pencil sharpener and move it approximately 15 cm right, out of the tray's path.

targets.other_notes: Paper may fall out if the tray is tilted.

targets.name: pencil sharpener
targets.description: Black electric pencil sharpener with a clear shavings bin, standing alone in front of the letter tray, its cord running off to the right.
targets.other_notes: Plugged in; must be unplugged before it is moved.

source: Staged permutation of S0023 and S0027, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
